theorems.name: Submission.second_fundamental_form_symm_normal_of_chart_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ ψ x a) (fderiv ℝ ψ x b) = normalPart M (ψ x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x a b)) → ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, secondFundamentalForm M y τ η = secondFundamentalForm M y η τ ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η) v = 0
